name: NBER Conference: Assessing the US Medical Innovation System
organizer: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Center for Aging and Health Research; organizers Stacie Dusetzina, Bhaven Sampat
conf_dates_note: Page header gives February 5, 2027; the body text says 'Friday, February 5, 2026' (apparent typo; 5 Feb 2027 is a Friday).
submission_requirements: Papers or extended abstracts via the NBER conference submission system; work may be at various stages but results must be ready for presentation. Not limited to NBER affiliates; early-career researchers and economics-adjacent fields welcome.
